import pytest


def shout(xs: list[str]) -> None:
    """Print every string upper-cased on its own line."""
    for s in xs:
        print(s.upper())


def test_shout_empty(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout([])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == ""


def test_shout_single_word(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["hello"])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "HELLO\n"


def test_shout_multiple_words(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["hello", "world", "python 3.12!"])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "HELLO\nWORLD\nPYTHON 3.12!\n"


def test_shout_already_uppercase(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["YELL", "LOUD"])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "YELL\nLOUD\n"
